systems.title: Makinen improvement / decline overlay
systems.rule: Use prior-season turnover, scoring, point-differential and regression traits as evidence overlays for season-win candidates.
systems.body: The guide flags several regression clusters (including Chicago, Jacksonville, LA Rams, New England and Philadelphia) and improvement clusters involving teams such as Kansas City, Indianapolis, New Orleans, Tennessee and Washington.
systems.state: Evidence overlay only; do not promote a wager without current facts and price.

systems.title: VSiN betting-splits method
systems.rule: Use DraftKings bet percentages for public positioning, Circa ticket-vs-dollar discrepancies for sharp action, and line movement as confirmation.
systems.body: The source specifically warns that early splits can change and recommends greater weight on the final 24 hours before kickoff.
systems.state: Runtime method card; only useful when current split and line data are available.
